sources: Sources: Reuters, Associated Press, CNN, Al Jazeera, The Hindu, SCMP, Xinhua — 22 Nov 2026. Figures as reported on the day; casualty counts may be revised.

stories.headline: COP31 Collapses Without a Deal
stories.summary: Nearly 200 nations fail to agree as the EU rejects a draft with no mention of fossil fuels.

stories.headline: Iran Hits Bahrain Site; Tankers Struck in Hormuz
stories.summary: Bahrain says two were wounded in Saturday's strike on a civilian site in Sitra, as two tankers are hit in the Strait of Hormuz.

stories.headline: Democrats Win Biggest House Majority Since 1992
stories.summary: Chuck Hubbard beats Virginia Foxx by 330 votes after a recount in North Carolina.

stories.headline: US Lead Over China Narrows to Record Low
stories.summary: America scores 78.9 in the 2026 Asia Power Index, just 5.3 ahead of China at 73.6 — the smallest gap since 2018.

stories.headline: BepiColombo Reaches Mercury — With a Glitch
stories.summary: After an eight-year flight, the probe enters Mercury's orbit, but a thruster burn falls short.

stories.headline: Alcaraz and Márquez Crowned Champions
stories.summary: Alcaraz beats world No. 1 Zverev 6-2, 7-6(7) for his first ATP Finals title; Márquez seals his eighth MotoGP crown, tying Agostini.
